metadata.title: Retro Soul Portrait with Multiline Inline Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s soul aesthetic featuring a low-key studio portrait of a woman in a patterned dress, framed by a thin red border and accented with multiline inline display type.
triggerTerms: low-key studio portrait with red border

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, crouching female figure with an afro hairstyle wearing a vibrant, earth-toned patterned dress against a dark, textured studio background. The composition is enclosed in a thin red rectangular frame, with bold, multiline inline typography overlapping the subject and a secondary stamped red title in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject breaking the top edge of the internal red frame
High contrast between dark background and vibrant dress patterns
Typography layered between the background and the subject's silhouette
Diagonal tension between top-left text and central subject
coreInvariants: Earth-tone floral or geometric dress patterns

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central crouching figure, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and afro, positioned at the top-center of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red text in the top left, moves down to the multiline name, then follows the dress patterns to the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy, dark negative space surrounding the figure to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black background providing a low-key base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant reds, yellows, and purples within the dress pattern.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red for the border and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low value background with high saturation accents in the clothing and graphics.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a multiline inline effect (3-4 parallel lines forming the stroke)
Secondary title uses a heavy, condensed block sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Rounded terminals on the multiline font to suggest a neon or tubular look

composition.position: Top left of the inner frame
Top left corner, outside/above inner frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a decorative multiline display face and a functional heavy block face.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy condensed secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-key studio photograph of a woman with an afro in a 70s patterned dress, crouching against a dark textured wall, framed by a thin red line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large multiline inline white text in the upper left, and a smaller red block text tilted 15 degrees in the far top left corner.

verificationChecks: Does the main text have multiple internal lines?
Is the lighting moody and low-key?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not look like a modern digital overlay.
Ensure the red border is a single thin line.
Verify the afro hairstyle is voluminous and central.
Confirm the dress pattern has a vintage earth-tone palette.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Low-key Studio Portrait] + [70s Patterned Fashion] + [Thin Red Frame] + [Multiline Inline Typography] to recreate this soul-era aesthetic.
